stories.title: Token infrastructure: BaseTheme.axaml dual-variant rewrite
acceptanceCriteria: BaseTheme.axaml uses nested <Styles ThemeVariant=Light> and <Styles ThemeVariant=Dark> blocks
Both variants define all 20 color tokens (Bg0/1/2/Hover/Selected, AccentBg, BorderSubtle/Strong, FgPrimary/Secondary/Dim/Numeric/OnBrand, Brand/Strong/Soft, Success, Warning, Danger, FocusRing)
Within each variant, Color-to-Brush bindings use StaticResource (same scope)

Shared resources block (variant-independent) defines fonts, density (RowHeightCompact=28, RowHeight=32, RowHeightComfortable=40, ControlHeight=36, ControlHeightLg=44), radius (RadiusSm=4, Radius=6, RadiusMd=8, RadiusLg=12), font sizes (Fs xs/sm/base/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl=40/4xl=56)
Style classes defined: DataGrid.compact, DataGrid.comfortable, Button.primary, Button.danger, Button.ghost, Button.lg, TextBlock.numeric, TextBlock.label
App.axaml RequestedThemeVariant=Dark default
ThemeConstants.cs static brush fields removed; only non-color constants remain
